top_choice_rationale: P001 honours an unbroken, decades-replicated arc from GLP-1 physiology (Holst, Drucker) to the pharmacokinetic design of long-acting analogues (Knudsen), validated by large independent outcome trials in type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal disease. The discovery is mature, each named laureate has a distinct and decisive contribution, and the citation states both the physiology and its translation. The contested third name (Mojsov or Habener priority) is a real weakness but does not outweigh the achievement, so no award is clearly worse.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I trained with Paul Greengard (not a candidate) and have about twenty co-authored works with committee colleague Thomas Perlmann on unrelated dopamine neuron topics, neither of which requires recusal
